svg.title: C1q binding to clustered IgG
svg.desc: Native cartoon rebuilt from the current detailed component style; not a recolored copy of the old PIRCHE geometry. Six C1q heads face Fc of six separately spaced detailed IgG cartoons. Conceptual side projection, not atomic docking.
